description: Source code implementing elliptic curve operations for the NIST P-256 curve in BoringSSL, including point addition, doubling, scalar multiplication, and conversion between coordinate systems, with support for different platform bit-widths.

methods.name: fiat_p256_nz
methods.description: Checks if the given field element is non-zero.

methods.name: fiat_p256_copy
methods.description: Copies one field element to another.

methods.name: fiat_p256_cmovznz
methods.description: Constant-time conditional move based on zero/non-zero flag.

methods.name: fiat_p256_inv_square
methods.description: Computes the inverse square of a field element.

methods.name: fiat_p256_point_double
methods.description: Calculates point doubling in Jacobian coordinates.

methods.name: fiat_p256_point_add
methods.description: Calculates point addition in Jacobian coordinates.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp256_point_mul
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication of a point.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp256_point_mul_base
methods.description: Scalar multiplication of the base point.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp256_point_mul_public
methods.description: Multiplies a point by a scalar, used for public key operations.

methods.name: ec_GFp_nistp256_cmp_x_coordinate
methods.description: Compares the x-coordinate of a point with a scalar.
